We are hiring: MLOps Engineer Coforge Ltd.




We are inviting applications for an experienced MLOps Engineer with strong expertise in continual learning, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure.




The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in deploying, monitoring, and optimizing Machine Learning and Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines across cloud platforms.





Join This WhatsApp Group for Regular and Quick Job Updates.

WhatsApp: 9667427662




Interview Details:-



Interview Dates: 13th June 2026 - Saturday
Mode: Microsoft Teams (Video Call)
Time: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Duration: 45 Minutes




Job Details:-



Experience Required: 5 to 10 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Location: Greater Noida, Pune, and Hyderabad Only




Job Description:-




1. MLOps & LLMOps Pipeline Development:-



Design and implement end-to-end ML/LLM pipelines with focus on continual learning, retraining, and A/B testing
Integrate CI/CD pipelines for model deployment, versioning, and rollback




2. Cloud & Infrastructure Expertise:-



Strong hands-on experience with Azure, AWS, and GCP (Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI)
Expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, and scalable cloud-native architectures




3. ML & LLM Tools & Frameworks:-



Experience with ML tools: MLflow, Airflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML
Knowledge of LLM frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs
Hands-on experience with vector databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, Qdrant




4. Monitoring, Optimization & Scalability:-



Implement monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog
Optimize GPU utilization, inference latency, and model performance




5. Programming & Collaboration:-



Strong Python skills with knowledge of Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver production-grade ML/LLM solutions
